task_completion.description: Patient waiting area contains seating for at least 20 people.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Count at least 20 chairs or sofa seats arranged in a waiting area configuration in the 2D plan or 3D view.

task_completion.description: A reception counter is placed in the waiting area.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A desk or counter-style furniture item positioned near the entrance/waiting area, typically with a chair behind it.

task_completion.description: At least two examination rooms are furnished with an exam table, physician chair, and patient chair each.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Two distinct rooms each containing a medical exam table/couch, a desk chair (physician), and an additional side chair (patient).

task_completion.description: A nurse workstation with a desk is present.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A desk designated for staff use, separate from the reception and exam rooms, often located in a hallway or central area.

task_completion.description: A restroom is included and accessible from the waiting area.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A room containing a toilet and sink with a door leading directly from or very near the waiting area.

task_completion.description: The layout is saved to the specific path /home/ga/Documents/clinic_layout.sh3d.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save As' dialog box showing the specific file path and name, or the application title bar reflecting the saved filename.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to place furniture.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the furniture catalog, dragging items into the 2D plan, and adjusting their positions.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply open an existing completed file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the progression of adding furniture items one by one or in groups to the empty building shell.

integrity.description: The agent did not use terminal commands to generate the .sh3d file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen using the graphical interface of Sweet Home 3D rather than just executing scripts in a terminal to produce the final file.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent starts with a file named 'medical_clinic_starter.sh3d' which contains only the building shell. The final score is based on the presence of specific furniture: 20+ seats and a counter in waiting area; 2 exam rooms (each with exam table, physician chair, patient chair); a nurse desk; and a restroom. The final file must be saved as /home/ga/Documents/clinic_layout.sh3d.
